topics.label: Introduction and Framework of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives, tumor progression model, and organizational framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Factor Independence and Proliferative Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained cellular proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Blockade of Terminal Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic mutations prevent cancer cells from completing normal lineage differentiation in hematopoietic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how mutations in the p53 pathway and shifts in mitochondrial apoptotic regulators enable cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Telomere Maintenance, Senescence, and Replicative Immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere shortening triggers senescence and how cancer cells bypass these tumor-suppressive limits to divide indefinitely.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the transition toward aerobic glycolysis and the reciprocal relationship between metabolic enzyme alterations and epigenetic regulation.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how expanding tumors activate the angiogenic switch to recruit vasculature for oxygen and nutrient delivery.

topics.label: The Metastatic Cascade and Clonal Colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the multistep process of cancer cell dissemination, circulating biomarkers, and the genomic features underlying metastatic colonization.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes by summarizing the integration of hallmarks and providing final housekeeping remarks.
